description: Hand-labelled compensation extras for extractCompExtras (server/keywords.js). Each excerpt keeps the sentences of the real posting (description text + salary summary) that mention equity/stock/bonus/commission/OTE/incentives, max 8 sentences of <=320 chars; postings without such sentences keep their first 160 chars.
labeller: features agent (Claude), read each posting's candidate sentences in context; 2026-10-02

guidelines.equity: true iff the text says this hire's compensation includes or may include employer equity: equity/equity grants/participation/options, RSUs, restricted stock, stock options/grants, "Offers Equity", "+ Equity", ESPP. false for DEI senses (pay/health equity, diversity equity inclusion), equity as job subject matter (payroll, equity accounting/admin, private/growth equity, equity research), "optional equity donation matching" (a donation benefit, not a statement about the offer), hedges ("this estimate excludes ... long-term incentives"), and boilerplate scoped to full-time offers on intern/co-op/contract postings.
guidelines.bonus: true iff the text says this hire's compensation includes or may include a bonus or variable pay: sign-on/annual/performance bonus, "+ Bonus", bonus-eligible, commission, OTE/on-target earnings, incentive/variable compensation, "Offers Commission". false for nice-to-have senses ("It's a bonus if you have", "Bonus:", "Bonus points"), "commission" as a verb (commission systems), compensation work as job duties, hedges ("excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus"), and "For sales roles ... OTE" boilerplate on postings that are not quota-carrying sales roles.

items.title: Senior Manager, Workforce Accounting
items.excerpt:
You will own every number tied to how we pay, equip and reward the people who work here: payroll and accrued compensation, stock-based compensation benefits and relocation, commissions, contingent workers, and travel and expense.
As headcount grows across new entities and geographies, equity programmes are becoming more complex, and the systems that feed payroll, equity and expense data into the ledger are still being wired together.
Own the workforce portfolio through month-end and quarter-end close — payroll and accrued compensation, bonus, vacation, severance and retention accruals, benefits, relocation, commissions, contingent workers, and T&E — including reconciliations, journal entries and variance commentary
Own stock-based compensation accounting end to end: expense recognition under ASC 718, cash-settlement matching, equity roll-forwards, and reconciliation of preferred stock, common stock and additional paid-in capital to the equity administration platform
